text: [342] 71 chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo tatra taterava sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyatane katamehi chahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ime hānabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ime ṭhitibhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ime visesabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ime nibbedhabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti asakkaccakārī ca hoti asappāyakārī ca imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo tatra taterava sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyatane . chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo tatra taterava sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyatane katamehi chahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ime hānabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ime ṭhitibhāgiyā 1 dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ime visesabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ime nibbedhabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti sakkaccakārī ca hoti sappāyakārī ca imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo tatra taterava sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyataneti .
